theme: recorded sessions as the main source

entries.text: Session 1 of the recording series. They talked about conflict with their teenage son and feeling powerless.
They practised listening to their son without fixing. Noticed anger comes from fear for him.
They listened to their son for ten minutes without giving advice. He talked more than in months.
They reported the conversation went well. Next step: say their own worry calmly.
Told their son calmly they worry when he comes home late. He rolled his eyes but texted the next time.
Reviewed progress. Still hard when the son shouts back; they still shout in return sometimes.

theme: names of real people should become roles

expect.note: Names use roles (a colleague, your therapist, your sister), not Tom, Anna or Kasia.

entries.text: Tom from accounting criticised them in front of everyone. They said nothing and stewed all day.
Session with Anna about the colleague who criticises in public. They practised a short calm sentence to say next time.
Tom did it again. They said: I would rather talk about this one to one. He stopped.
Felt calmer at work this week. Told their sister Kasia about it.

Angry after a call with the bank. Ran, then called back calmly.
Worried again before the test. Wrote the control list. Slept okay.

theme: pride in small wins after depression talk

entries.text: Talked about the depression diagnosis from last year and how small wins get lost. Their therapist suggested writing one small win a day.
Small win: made breakfast and went outside. Wrote it down.
Small win: called the dentist I had been avoiding.
Small win list has twenty items. They read it on a bad day and felt a little proud.
They noticed they now see wins without writing them.
Small win: finished a book. Proud.
